sections.title: Three concrete experiments
sections.summary: Run these before increasing build scope.

statements.text: Problem-frequency interviews: Interview 8 qualified Small GitHub-based software agencies and software consultancies; capture the last occurrence, current workaround, frequency, consequence, and owner. Success: At least 5 describe a recent occurrence and 3 actively seek a better workflow.
Concierge workflow pilot: Run the core workflow manually with 3 teams for 14 days; log repeated use, completion time, and abandonment. Success: At least 2 teams use it twice and ask to continue.

Paid-offer test: Present the same scoped offer to 5 qualified buyers and request payment, a deposit, or a signed paid-pilot commitment. Success: At least 2 buyers make a monetary or signed commitment.

experiments.name: Problem-frequency interviews
experiments.method: Interview 8 qualified Small GitHub-based software agencies and software consultancies; capture the last occurrence, current workaround, frequency, consequence, and owner.
experiments.hypothesis: Small GitHub-based software agencies and software consultancies experience A lightweight pull-request approval and audit-trail service for small GitHub-based software agencies, centralizing review requests, reminders, client sign-off, and immutable approval records. often enough to change behaviour.
experiments.failureCriterion: Fewer than 3 report a recent, consequential occurrence.
experiments.successCriterion: At least 5 describe a recent occurrence and 3 actively seek a better workflow.

experiments.name: Concierge workflow pilot
experiments.method: Run the core workflow manually with 3 teams for 14 days; log repeated use, completion time, and abandonment.
experiments.hypothesis: A narrow assisted workflow creates repeat usage before automation is built.
experiments.failureCriterion: Teams revert to their existing workflow or need unrelated features to participate.
experiments.successCriterion: At least 2 teams use it twice and ask to continue.

experiments.name: Paid-offer test
experiments.method: Present the same scoped offer to 5 qualified buyers and request payment, a deposit, or a signed paid-pilot commitment.
experiments.hypothesis: Free for up to 10 users is valuable enough to trigger a real commitment.
experiments.failureCriterion: Interest remains verbal or depends on unsupported feature expansion.
experiments.successCriterion: At least 2 buyers make a monetary or signed commitment.
